headline: Chalone Peaks cross country captures 11 medals, sweeps team titles at Atwater
summary: KING CITY — Chalone Peaks Middle School’s cross country team continued its impressive second season at the Amanda Garcia Memorial on Oct. 3 in Atwater, bringing home two team victories and 11 individual medals.
